evals.prompt: Build a search box component that POSTs { keyword } to /api/search as the user types (300 ms debounce) and shows loading, results and errors.
evals.expected_output: Uses `useDebouncedFetcherQuery` with `debounce: { delay: 300 }` and an explicit `autoExecute: true` (off by default for debounced hooks), `setQuery` on input, `run`/`cancel`/`isPending()`; renders `loading`, `result`, `error`.

evals.prompt: useFetcher gives me result.data undefined for GET /users/1 — how do I get the parsed user?
evals.expected_output: Explains `useFetcher`'s default result is the FetchExchange; pass `resultExtractor: ResultExtractors.Json` (or read the exchange's response).

evals.prompt: I call execute(fetch("/api/x")) with useExecutePromise and it runs twice and ignores abort.
evals.expected_output: Passes a PromiseSupplier `(abortController) => fetch(url, { signal: abortController.signal })`, not a promise; reads data from `result`/`onSuccess` because execute resolves to void.

evals.prompt: Generate React hooks from my decorator-based UserService so components can call getUser and updateUser.
evals.expected_output: `createQueryApiHooks({ api: userService })` for query-style methods and/or `createExecuteApiHooks({ api: userService })` producing `use<Method>` hooks; notes execute hooks do not forward the AbortController.

evals.prompt: After upgrading to Fetcher 6, usePagedQuery is no longer exported from @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT primarily use this skill: removed hooks are covered by $fetcher-v6-migration.
